name: Call Recorder
author: illegalstudio
description: Record microphone and desktop audio with live controls

barWidget.description: Live call recording controls and audio meters

schema.label: Preferred microphone
schema.description: Leave empty to use the default microphone when recording starts.

schema.label: Desktop output
schema.description: Leave empty to follow the system output while recording.

schema.label: Recording folder
schema.description: Parent folder for dated recordings. Leave empty for ~/Music/Recordings.

schema.label: Reminder interval (minutes)
schema.description: Notify every N minutes while recording. Set 0 to disable.
